Name: Meanwhile
Author: mouahrara
Description:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/Meanwhile/images/main.jpg[/img]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/Meanwhile/images/scrolls/01.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New][b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b][/font].[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Run the game using [b]SMAPI[/b].[/size][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/Meanwhile/images/scrolls/02.png[/img]

[size=3]When you're waiting for other players, three new buttons let you make the most of that time: play Journey of the Prairie King, play Junimo Kart, or spectate the other players. While spectating, switch from one player to another using the left and right arrow keys on your keyboard (or left shoulder and right shoulder on a controller).[/size]

[size=3]Note: The Play Junimo Kart button only shows up once you've unlocked it.[/size]

[size=3]See [url=https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8acab020-6ea0-4596-9ca1-3d6a9ac53eb0]demo[/url].[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/Meanwhile/images/scrolls/03.png[/img]

[size=3]English and French translations are included in the base mod, and contributions are welcome. To contribute, please submit a pull request on the [url=https://github.com/mouahrara/Meanwhile/pulls]GitHub repository[/url].[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/Meanwhile/images/scrolls/04.png[/img]

[size=3]Meanwhile is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.0+ on Linux/Mac/Windows/Android. It's only useful in multiplayer, since it's entirely about waiting for other players.[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/Meanwhile/images/scrolls/05.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=3][b]Can I use this mod on an existing save?[/b][/size]
[size=3]Yes, no problem at all.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Can I uninstall this mod without any issues?[/b][/size]
[size=3]Yes.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Do all connected players need to have the mod installed?[/b][/size]
[size=3]No, players without the mod will simply see the normal waiting screen without the extra buttons.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/Meanwhile/images/scrolls/06.png[/img]
